This trade would give me 2A, 1C, 0B, reducing variety instead of improving it. Since I value variety, going to zero in B while doubling A is unfavorable. I'd rather keep balanced holdings.
Giving up my only B would eliminate variety entirely, leaving me with 3A, 1C, 0B which is heavily imbalanced. I'd prefer a trade that keeps some balance across all three goods.

Trading away my only C for a second B would unbalance my bundle (1A,0C,2B), reducing variety value since I'd go from even distribution to having none of C. Better to seek a trade that doesn't deplete a good to zero.

Giving up my only B to get more C would leave me with zero B, hurting variety. I'd rather trade in smaller amounts that keep some balance across A, B, and C.
